verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु सौमित्रिं जातहर्षो विभीषणः।धनुष्पाणिनमादाय त्वरमाणो जगाम ह ।। ६.८७.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu saumitriṁ jātaharṣo vibhīṣaṇaḥ।dhanuṣpāṇinamādāya tvaramāṇo jagāma ha ।। 6.87.1 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Saumithri was satisfied. Wielding a bow Saumithri went quickly with Vibheeshana.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र के वतन के शब्द के समान मेघनाद का भयंकर सिंहनाद सुन, चारों ओर देखते हुए वे वानरश्रेष्ठ भागने लगे

verses.sloka: अविदूरं ततो गत्वा प्रविश्य च महद्वनम्।दर्शयामास तत्कर्म लक्ष्मणाय विभीषणः ।। ६.८७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: avidūraṁ tato gatvā praviśya ca mahadvanam।darśayāmāsa tatkarma lakṣmaṇāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.87.2 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Vibheeshana followed Lakshmana for a small distance to the forest and showed him What to do.
translations.hindi: तब उन तितर बितर हो भागते हुए, दुःखित तथा उदासीन मुख वानरों से पवननन्दन हनुमान जी बोले

verses.sloka: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशं न्यग्रोधं भीमदर्शनम्।तेजस्वी रावणभ्राता लक्ष्मणाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ६.८७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṁ nyagrodhaṁ bhīmadarśanam।tejasvī rāvaṇabhrātā lakṣmaṇāya nyavedayat ।। 6.87.3 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, the brilliant brother of Ravana, showed Lakshmana a banyan tree resembling a dark cloud, frightening to look at.
translations.hindi: हे वानरों ! तुम दुखी हो क्यों भागे जाते हो? तुम तो शूर हो, फिर युद्ध को छोड़ तुम लोग कहाँ जा रहे हो अथवा तुम युद्धोत्साह क्यों त्यागते हो ? तुम्हारी वह शूरता कहाँ चली गई ?

verses.sloka: इहोपहारं भूतानां बलवान् रावणात्मजः।उपहृत्य ततः पश्चात् सङ्ग्राममभिवर्तते ।। ६.८७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ihopahāraṁ bhūtānāṁ balavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ।upahṛtya tataḥ paścāt saṅgrāmamabhivartate ।। 6.87.4 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty son of Ravana having offered oblations for all beings he comes to the battlefield. (Said Vibheeshana)"
translations.hindi: अच्छा में लड़ने के लिए आगे बढ़ता हूँ | तुम सब मेरे पीछे पीछे चले आओ | शूरों ओर कुलीनों का यह काम नहीं हैं, कि युद्ध से मुख मोड

verses.sloka: अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति राक्षसः।निहन्ति समरे शत्रून् बध्नाति च शरोत्तमैः ।। ६.८७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ tato bhavati rākṣasaḥ।nihanti samare śatrūn badhnāti ca śarottamaiḥ ।। 6.87.5 ।।

translations.english: "Thereafter he becomes invisible for all beings and kills his enemies with the best of arrows and binds them."
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार जब पवननन्दन हनुमान्‌ जीने उन सब र उत्साहित किआ, तब उन सब वानरों ने उत्साहित हो और रोष में भर हाथों में शिलाओं और पेड़ों को ले लिआ

verses.sloka: तमप्रविष्टन्यग्रोधं बलिनं रावणात्मजम्।विध्वंसय शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सरथं साश्वसारथिम् ।। ६.८७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamapraviṣṭanyagrodhaṁ balinaṁ rāvaṇātmajam।vidhvaṁsaya śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ sarathaṁ sāśvasārathim ।। 6.87.6 ।।

translations.english: "Before he enters the banyan tree, you destroy Indrajith, with his chariot, horses and charioteer by the flaming arrows"
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे _तद॒न्तर वे समस्त वानरश्रेष्ठ हनुमान जी को घेरे हुए और गर्जते हुए उस महासमर में अग्रसर हुए

verses.sloka: तथेत्युक्त्वा महातेजाः सौमित्रिर्मित्रनन्दनः।बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र चित्रं विस्फारयन् धनुः ।। ६.८७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathetyuktvā mahātejāḥ saumitrirmitranandanaḥ।babhūvāvasthitastatra citraṁ visphārayan dhanuḥ ।। 6.87.7 ।।

translations.english: Brilliant Saumithri, delighted by his friends, twanging his wonderful bow stood there, after Vibheeshana had spoken to him.
translations.hindi: हनुमान्‌ जी प्रधान प्रधान वानरों के साथ वैसे ही शोभा य- मान होकर, जैसे अभि अनी शिखाओं से शोभित होता है, शत्रु की सेना को भस्म करने लगे

verses.sloka: स रथेनाग्निवर्णेन बलवान् रावणात्मजः।इन्द्रजित् कवची धन्वी सध्वजः प्रत्यदृश्यत ।। ६.८७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rathenāgnivarṇena balavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ।indrajit kavacī dhanvī sadhvajaḥ pratyadṛśyata ।। 6.87.8 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, who was endowed with mighty prowess, armed with shield and sword, appeared like glowing gold in the chariot decorated with a post.

verses.sloka: तमुवाच महातेजाः पौलस्त्यमपराजितम्।समाह्वये त्वां समरे सम्यग्युद्धं प्रयच्छ मे ।। ६.८७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ paulastyamaparājitam।samāhvaye tvāṁ samare samyagyuddhaṁ prayaccha me ।। 6.87.9 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana of extraordinary energy, spoke to Indrajith of the Paulastya clan," I challenge you to fight in battle directly. Fight with me."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो महातेजा मनस्वी रावणात्मजः।अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं तत्र दृष्ट्वा विभीषणम् ।। ६.८७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahātejā manasvī rāvaṇātmajaḥ।abravīt paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ tatra dṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.87.10 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way, highly energetic and strong minded Indrajith seeing Vibheeshana spoke to him harshly as follows.

verses.sloka: इह त्वं जातसंवृद्धः साक्षाद्भ्राता पितुर्मम।कथं द्रुह्यसि पुत्रस्य पितृव्यो मम राक्षस ।। ६.८७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: iha tvaṁ jātasaṁvṛddhaḥ sākṣādbhrātā piturmama।kathaṁ druhyasi putrasya pitṛvyo mama rākṣasa ।। 6.87.11 ।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! You are born here and brought up by my father. You are my father'sbrother also. How can you be hostile to your son?"

verses.sloka: न ज्ञातित्वं न सौहार्दं न जातिस्तव दुर्मते।प्रमाणं न च सौदर्यं न धर्मो धर्मदूषण ।। ६.८७.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: na jñātitvaṁ na sauhārdaṁ na jātistava durmate।pramāṇaṁ na ca saudaryaṁ na dharmo dharmadūṣaṇa ।। 6.87.12 ।।

translations.english: "Evil minded Vibheeshana! You are vitiating righteousness, have no value to your race, no affection to your clan, no brotherly feeling and have no righteousness."

verses.sloka: शोच्यस्त्वमसि दुर्बुद्धे निन्दनीयश्च साधुभिः।यस्त्वं स्वजनमुत्सृज्य परभृत्यत्वमागतः ।। ६.८७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: śocyastvamasi durbuddhe nindanīyaśca sādhubhiḥ।yastvaṁ svajanamutsṛjya parabhṛtyatvamāgataḥ ।। 6.87.13 ।।

translations.english: "You are evil minded, think. You are pitiable and to be blamed for you have abandoned your own people and sought the enemy's protection."
translations.hindi: उस समय बड़े बड़े बलवान्‌ सैकड़ों वानर पर्बेतशिखरों और क्षों को लिये हुए और गजते हुए

verses.sloka: नैतच्छिथिलया बुद्ध्या त्वं वेत्सि महदन्तरम्।क्वच स्वजनसंवासः क्वच नीचपराश्रयः ।। ६.८७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: naitacchithilayā buddhyā tvaṁ vetsi mahadantaram।kvaca svajanasaṁvāsaḥ kvaca nīcaparāśrayaḥ ।। 6.87.14 ।।

translations.english: "You do not seem to have an understanding of the difference between living with one's own people and seeking refuge from strangers. Your intellect has slackened you are not knowing."
translations.hindi: विविध प्रकार से सिंहनाद करते हुए भयङ्कर आकार वाले आर महाबलबान्‌ बानरों ने भयङ्कर रूपवाले शत्रु राक्षसों का बड़ा. नाश किया

verses.sloka: गुणवान् वा परजनः स्वजनो निर्गुणो ऽपि वा।निर्गुणः स्वजनः श्रेयान् यः परः पर एव सः ।। ६.८७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: guṇavān vā parajanaḥ svajano nirguṇo 'pi vā।nirguṇaḥ svajanaḥ śreyān yaḥ paraḥ para eva saḥ ।। 6.87.15 ।।

translations.english: "Even if others are virtuous and your own people are not virtuous also one should seek the refuge of one's own people. Strangers are always strangers."

verses.sloka: यः स्वपक्षं परित्यज्य परपक्षं निषेवते।स स्वपक्षे क्षयं प्राप्ते पश्चात्तैरेव हन्यते ।। ६.८७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svapakṣaṁ parityajya parapakṣaṁ niṣevate।sa svapakṣe kṣayaṁ prāpte paścāttaireva hanyate ।। 6.87.16 ।।

translations.english: "He who renounces his own kind and seeks refuge from others, will be destroyed by others whose refuge he sought when his own people are destroyed."
translations.hindi: चानरों ने भी उसके साथी रासो को मारा । महाबलवान्‌. हचुमान्‌ जी ने भी स्कन्ध और शाखायुक्त शालइक्ञ और शिलाओं केदार र्‌ से क्ररकमा राक्षसा का नाश किआ | फिर शत्रुसैन्य को गा कर हनुमान्‌ जी ने वानरों से कहा, चलो अब लौट चल, "५ ळा. - दूव्यशीतितम: सगः ६०४ क्योकि यह सेना हमारे मान की नहीं है | हम लोग तो अरबी जानों को हथेलियों पर रख, श्रीरामैचन्द्र जी का काम छर्है थे

verses.sloka: निरनुक्रोशता चेयं यादृशी ते निशाचर।स्वजनेन त्वया शक्यं परुषं रावणानुज ।। ६.८७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: niranukrośatā ceyaṁ yādṛśī te niśācara।svajanena tvayā śakyaṁ paruṣaṁ rāvaṇānuja ।। 6.87.17 ।।

translations.english: "O Ravana's brother! You have shown ruthlessness this way. O night ranger! Only you could exhibit this kind of manliness."
translations.hindi: वह रोष में भर गया और अपना घलुष उठा शात्रुवानरों का सामना करने को आगे बढ़ा। वह॒ अपनी राक्षस सेना से घिरा हुआ, 'अघंख्य बाण छोड़ने लगा

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तो भ्रातृपुत्रेण प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.८७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityukto bhrātṛputreṇa pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.87.18 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith having spoken like that, Vibheeshana replied," why do you speak like that as though you do not know my disposition?"

verses.sloka: अजानन्निव मच्छीलं किं राक्षस विकत्थसे।राक्षसेन्द्रसुतासाधो पारुष्यं त्यज गौरवात् ।। ६.८७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ajānanniva macchīlaṁ kiṁ rākṣasa vikatthase।rākṣasendrasutāsādho pāruṣyaṁ tyaja gauravāt ।। 6.87.19 ।।

translations.english: "Impious son of Rakshasa king! Though born in the Rakshasa clan I renounced cruel deeds and followed respectfully manliness as my primary quality. My nature is not like that of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: कुले यद्यप्यहं जातो रक्षसां क्रूरकर्मणाम्।गुणो ऽयं प्रथमो नृणां तन्मे शीलमराक्षसम् ।। ६.८७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: kule yadyapyahaṁ jāto rakṣasāṁ krūrakarmaṇām।guṇo 'yaṁ prathamo nṛṇāṁ tanme śīlamarākṣasam ।। 6.87.20 ।।

translations.english: "I do not delight in cruel deeds, nor follow unrighteousness. Or else because of unfavourable disposition how can a brother be expelled by a brother?"

verses.sloka: न रमे दारुणेनाहं न चाधर्मेण वै रमे।भ्रात्रा विषमशीलेन कथं भ्राता निरस्यते ।। ६.८७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: na rame dāruṇenāhaṁ na cādharmeṇa vai rame।bhrātrā viṣamaśīlena kathaṁ bhrātā nirasyate ।। 6.87.21 ।।

translations.english: "The association of one who has renounced righteousness and is of sinful deeds is left by a righteous man who undoubtedly attains happiness, is like shaking of a venomous serpent from the hand."

verses.sloka: धर्मात् प्रच्युतशीलं हि पुरुषं पापनिश्चयम्।त्यक्त्वा सुखमवाप्नोति हस्तादाशीविषं यथा ।। ६.८७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharmāt pracyutaśīlaṁ hi puruṣaṁ pāpaniścayam।tyaktvā sukhamavāpnoti hastādāśīviṣaṁ yathā ।। 6.87.22 ।।

translations.english: "Seizing the property of others, uniting with others wife, evil mindedness is said to be given up like getting out of a burning house."
translations.hindi: यन्चिमित्त हि युध्यामो हता सा जनकात्मजा । इममर्थं हि विज्ञाप्य रामं सुग्रीवसेव खू-)२२॥ किन्तु जिनके लिए हम लड़ते थे वह आ न्दिनी तो माशी ही गई । चलो अब यह संवाद श्रीरामचन्द्र ओर सुग्रीवो झुनाबें

verses.sloka: हिंसापरस्वहरणे परदाराभिमर्शनम्।त्याज्यमाहुर्दुराचारं वेश्म प्रज्वलितं यथा ।। ६.८७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: hiṁsāparasvaharaṇe paradārābhimarśanam।tyājyamāhurdurācāraṁ veśma prajvalitaṁ yathā ।। 6.87.23 ।।

translations.english: "Stealing the wealth of others, possessing others wife, distrusting friends, these three faults will destroy a person."

verses.sloka: परस्वानां च हरणं परदाराभिमर्शनम्।सुहृदामतिशङ्का च त्रयो दोषाः क्षयाबहाः ।। ६.८७.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: parasvānāṁ ca haraṇaṁ paradārābhimarśanam।suhṛdāmatiśaṅkā ca trayo doṣāḥ kṣayābahāḥ ।। 6.87.24 ।।

translations.english: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."
translations.hindi: बे धीरे धारे निभय हो सेना सहित लोट पड़े । हनुमान जीं को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास जाते देखे

verses.sloka: महर्षिणां वधो घोरः सर्वदेवैश्च विग्रहः।अभिमानश्च कोपश्च वैरित्वं प्रतिकूलता ।। ६.८७.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: maharṣiṇāṁ vadho ghoraḥ sarvadevaiśca vigrahaḥ।abhimānaśca kopaśca vairitvaṁ pratikūlatā ।। 6.87.25 ।।

translations.english: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."

verses.sloka: एते दोषा मम भ्रातुर्जीवितैश्वर्यनाशनाः।गुणान् प्रच्छादयामासुः पर्वतानिव तोयदाः।दोषैरेतैः परित्यक्तो मया भ्राता पिता तव ।। ६.८७.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ete doṣā mama bhrāturjīvitaiśvaryanāśanāḥ।guṇān pracchādayāmāsuḥ parvatāniva toyadāḥ।doṣairetaiḥ parityakto mayā bhrātā pitā tava ।। 6.87.26 ।।

translations.english: "Because of these faults your father and my brother has been abandoned by me from this Lanka. This Lanka will not be there, nor your father and you too."

verses.sloka: नेयमस्ति पुरी लङ्का न च त्वं न च ते पिता ।। ६.८७.२७ ।।्छादयामासुः पर्वतानिव तोयदाः।अतिमानी च बालश्च दुर्विनीतश्च राक्षस।बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन ब्रूहि मां यद्यदिच्छसि ।। ६.८७.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: neyamasti purī laṅkā na ca tvaṁ na ca te pitā ।। 6.87.27 ।।्chādayāmāsuḥ parvatāniva toyadāḥ।atimānī ca bālaśca durvinītaśca rākṣasa।baddhastvaṁ kālapāśena brūhi māṁ yadyadicchasi ।। 6.87.28 ।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! You are mean, proud of might, immoral and bound by the noose of death. Whatever you wish to say you may say."
translations.hindi: ज्याला से युक्त एवं रक्त की आहुति से ठप्त हुआ वह अभि, सन्ध्याकालीन सूये की तरह ढक्रा हुआ सा देख पड़ने लगा

verses.sloka: अद्य ते व्यसनं प्राप्तं किं मां त्वमिह वक्ष्यसि।प्रवेष्टुं न त्वया शक्यो न्यग्रोधो राक्षसाधम ।। ६.८७.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya te vyasanaṁ prāptaṁ kiṁ māṁ tvamiha vakṣyasi।praveṣṭuṁ na tvayā śakyo nyagrodho rākṣasādhama ।। 6.87.29 ।।

translations.english: "O Lowly Rakshasa! This worry has come to you today. Entering the banyan tree is not possible for you today."

verses.sloka: धर्षयित्वा च काकुत्स्थौ न शक्यं जीवितुं त्वया।युद्ध्यस्व नरदेवेन लक्ष्मणेन रणे सह।हतस्त्वं देवताकार्यं करिष्यसि यमक्षये ।। ६.८७.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: dharṣayitvā ca kākutsthau na śakyaṁ jīvituṁ tvayā।yuddhyasva naradevena lakṣmaṇena raṇe saha।hatastvaṁ devatākāryaṁ kariṣyasi yamakṣaye ।। 6.87.30 ।।

translations.english: "Clashing with Lakshmana of Kakuthsa clan is not possible for you. By waging war with Lakshmana, you will be killed and reaching the abode of the Lord of death. You will be doing tasks of deities of Devatas."

verses.sloka: निदर्शयस्वात्मबलं समुद्यतं कुरुष्व सर्वायुधसायकव्ययम्।न लक्ष्मणस्यैत्य हि बाणगोचरं त्वमद्य जीवन् सबलो गमिष्यसि ।। ६.८७.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: nidarśayasvātmabalaṁ samudyataṁ kuruṣva sarvāyudhasāyakavyayam।na lakṣmaṇasyaitya hi bāṇagocaraṁ tvamadya jīvan sabalo gamiṣyasi ।। 6.87.31 ।।

translations.english: 'Display your uplifted strength; expend all your weapons and shafts. For once come within the range of Lakshmana's arrows, you shall not this day go back alive with your army.'

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्ताशतीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptāśatītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 87 ।।
